summary:
Results-driven Software Engineer with over 6 months of Management Operations experiences
and 1.5 years of experience in developing and maintaining web applications using ASP.NET,
C#, and SQL Server. Skilled in full software development lifecycle, from requirement gathering
and coding to deployment and support. Adept at working in team environments and
delivering scalable, high-quality solutions.

bullets: Providing application support and management for business-critical systems.
Monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving issues to ensure smooth operations.
Coordinating with development and infrastructure teams for issue resolution.
Preparing technical documentation and user guides for supported applications.
Designed and developed web applications using ASP.NET (C#).
Worked on database-driven solutions using MS SQL Server.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver client requirements on time.
Improved application performance and fixed bugs to ensure smooth operations.

bullets: Assisted in development and maintenance of web applications.

Contributed to backend development and database queries in SQL Server. Internship: Web Development (ASP.NET, C#) – ESSAR Power Plant Company, Dwarka, Gujarat Project (MCA Final Year): Task Management System using ASP.NET & C#
